title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. My best friend has given birth to a girl child.Wondering whether she could be named insha? 2710 views Q. Kindly suggest some names for my son. one of my relative recomended "Muhammad Faaz" is it coorect name. 1622 views Q. Regarding name Laiba Anzar (لا ئبہ انظار ) 6851 views Q. ہمارے ایک دوست کا نام پرویز ہے۔ اس نام کی وجہ سے اس کو بہت فکر ہوتی ہے۔ اس کا خیال ہے کہ اس کی زندگی کی ہر پریشانی اس کے نام کی وجہ سے ہے۔ ہمارا سوال یہ ہے کہ کیا اسلام میں پرویز نام درست ہے؟ کیا اس نام کی وجہ سے کوئی شخص ذہنی، جسمانی پریشانی میں مبتلا ہوسکتا ہے اپنی زندگی میں؟ 2485 views Q. Asalam kum, My name is Mohammed Rafi, I want to know whether the word " RAFI " is islamic name and have any meaning ,because I have seen a jewish person with the name rafi. 3629 views Q. My wife is blessed with baby girl around 2 and half months back named her as "Sarah Manha". Please let me know is this name good for her 2810 views Q. What does the name Abbas mean? I know it was the name of our beloved Nabi (Sallallahu 'Alaihi wa Sallam), but what does that name mean? 1814 views Q. چالیس دن پہلے اللہ کے فضل سے بیٹی ہوئی ہے، ہم نے اس کا نام انابیہ (Anabia)رکھا ہے ۔ لوگ کہتے ہیں کہ یہ عربی یا اسلامی نام نہیں ہے ۔ 13734 views Q. Assalamu Alaikkum Mufti Sahib, I am Mohamed Kamil from Tamilnadu. Last week Allah blessed me with a Baby boy, Alhamdulillah. Now I need to select a name for him. I am very much interested in Tabligh Jamaat and I want my son also become a good Tayee for the world. Our local imam suggested the name as ?Mohamed?. Shall I keep the name as ?Mohamed? without adding any other name?. In my mind, I thought a name as ?Mohamed Hanif? or ?Mohamed Mahdi?. As I need to select a name as soon as possible, please give your suggestion on this. 2019 views Q. Brother Asalam Alaikum In a Islamic Name Book I saw a name Ribah , companion of our Prophet. I was inspired with this name and put the name Riba Enterprises to my new form company. I registered the firm and completed all government formalities. Now I come to know that the meaning of this word is interest which is looking very unislamic . I am upset very much . Although in my mind ( niyat ) it was Islamic . At this stage I am not in a position to change the name . Brother let me know what is the effect of name , it context , what should be answer if some one ask about the name, in respect to keep my niyat in mind.. Yours truly! 1675 views Q. My brother's full name is AHMAD AL MUHAIMIN (nick name MUHAIMIN). 2711 views Q. Asalaamulaikum, Please give me the meaning for the following names: Aameelah,sahla,faariah abbaad,sahl,qais,marwaan JAZAKALLAH 2644 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 49468 Country: India Title: Name Question: Could you please suggest a beautiful and good Islamic name for daughter born on Oct 02 2013 @ 7:02 PM mother name: GOSIA BANU and father Name: Tanveer Ahmed.B Answer ID: 49468 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 25/31/L=01/1435) You may keep the name ‘Sadia Bano’ for your daughter. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
